scope: post-hoc diagnostic of archived object predictions; no optimization or scene reselection

definition.unit: GT instance observation at one frame, not a unique object or independent trial
definition.current: same temporal weights with history disabled (primary); separately trained matched current (secondary)
definition.history: raw B0 prediction on same GT instance at frame t-1, 0 < age <= 0.75 s
definition.recognition: at least 50% correct among at least 5 uniquely assigned GT semantic points
definition.opportunity: current recognition fails and previous recognition succeeds
definition.repair: temporal recognition succeeds at the same current frame

limits: Does not measure whether the relevant historical feature survived storage or was retrieved
Does not bound feature-level joint inference when both standalone predictions are wrong
GT identity used for analysis only; model has no instance tracker
Object-frames and seeds are correlated; no independence or significance claim
